_README: This file is managed by LazyCue (see shelley/lazycue). Do NOT edit by hand — it is the cached, machine-generated DSL for a self-healing browser test. To change behavior, edit the test description and re-run LazyCue.
description:
"The container" is the messages container (".messages-container"), "the button" the scroll-to-bottom button (".scroll-to-bottom-button"), and "the gap" the container's scrollHeight - clientHeight - scrollTop. To "send" a message, fill the message input ([data-testid="message-input"]) with it and click the send button ([data-testid="send-button"]). Check every assertion with an eval that has "expect" (or an assert_* or wait_* step): an eval without "expect" asserts nothing. When a step says to record something, do it in one eval without "expect" that stores it in the named window variable, then check that variable. Perform the steps in order. The test seeds a conversation at /c/{{SLUG}} whose first message is "echo message 0". To "open the conversation", navigate to /c/{{SLUG}} and wait for the message input to be visible (allow 30s). To "add message N", send "echo message N" and wait until a [data-testid="message"] element containing the text "echo message N" is visible (allow 30s). A scroll-up the observer has not yet reported still disarms auto-follow.
1. Open the conversation.
2. Add message 1; then add message 2; then add message 3; then add message 4.
3. The button must not be visible (allow 5s).
4. A genuine scroll to the very top, as a bare scrollTop write so no wheel or touch handler runs: eval setting the container's scrollTop to 0 (nothing else). The button should become visible (allow 5s).
5. Record the container's scrollTop in window.__before; window.__before < 50 must be true.
6. Grow the list; auto-follow must stay disarmed, the user is reading: send "echo message 5" and wait until some [data-testid="message"] element's text contains "echo message 5" (it need not be visible; allow 30s).
7. Wait until the container's scrollTop is below 50 (allow 3s). The button must be visible.
